title: AUTO THROW ESP
features:
🧠 AIM ASSIST
Toggleable Aim Assist (default: OFF)

Smoothness/Pull slider (0.10–0.40, adjustable)

FOV limit (50°) + Max Distance cap (700 studs)

Prediction: Lead target based on movement velocity

Ignore teammates + ignore friends option

Aim Part selection: UpperTorso / Head

Max Correction angle (15°) — prevents over-snapping

Keybind: Q (customizable)

🌈 ESP / VISUALS
Master ESP Toggle

6 ESP Modes: Skeleton • Tracers • Both • NameOnly • Boxes • HeadDot

✅ Show Player Name Toggle (NEW)

✅ Show Distance Toggle (NEW) — shows distance in studs

Skeleton auto-adapts to R6 or R15 rigs

Team-color friendly teammates

Color Modes:

🌈 Rainbow (speed slider: 0.3–3.0)

🎨 Solid Color — pick from 6 presets OR custom color wheel

Line Thickness slider (1.0–3.0)

Max Distance culling (0–2000 studs)

Keybind: RightShift (customizable)

🎯 TRIGGERBOT
Toggleable Triggerbot (default: OFF)

Trigger Delay slider (0.02–0.30s) — safe & adjustable

Detects enemies under crosshair → auto-click

Ignores teammates & friends

Keybind: E (customizable)

⚠️ ALERT SYSTEM (OFF by default)
High-Level Alerts — notify when player ≥ threshold (50–500)

High Winstreak Alerts — notify when streak ≥ threshold (3–50)

Rusher Alerts — warn when enemy rushing toward you within range

Aim-Lock Alerts — warn when enemy looking directly at you

Backstab Alerts — warn when enemy behind you

All alerts show pop-up notification with details

🎨 UI & THEMES
Draggable clean modern UI with smooth open/close animation

5 Tabs: AIM • ESP • ALERT • TRIG • SETTINGS

10 Built-in Themes: NeonRed • NeonPurple • NeonAqua • NeonLime • NeonGold • DarkMatter • CrimsonVoid • ArcticBlue • ToxicGreen • RoyalNight

Live Status Bar — shows current ON/OFF state + active theme

All settings save automatically to file

Keybind rebinding UI — click to assign any key

Pop-up notifications on every change / toggle / save

💾 CONFIGURATION
Auto-creates & loads InvalidX_Config.json

Auto-updates config when new settings are added

All toggles, sliders, dropdowns, keybinds & themes persist between sessions

One-click Save / Auto-Save on every change

Remembers ESP colors, thresholds, distances, everything

✅ EXTRA FEATURES
Auto-detects new players & applies ESP instantly

Cleans up ESP when player leaves / dies

No self-ESP

Teammate auto-detection

Performance optimized — only draws what's on-screen & within range

Safe defaults — alerts OFF, aim/trigger OFF on fresh load

Cross-executor compatible

Clean console status on load
